svg.aria-label: FIFO and delay scheduling of the same 18 requests on 3 workers that each hold one renderer. FIFO switches renderers 17 times, delay scheduling 4 times; the average response drops from 223 ms to 128 ms.
svg.title: FIFO and delay scheduling of the same 18 requests on 3 workers that each hold one renderer. FIFO switches renderers 17 times, delay scheduling 4 times; the average response drops from 223 ms to 128 ms.
svg.text: a free worker takes the oldest request
a free worker takes, in order:
the oldest request has waited 1 s or more: take it (not reached here)
the queue has requests for a renderer this worker holds: take the oldest of them
the oldest request has waited the switch cost or more, or this worker holds no renderer: take it
else wait, up to the switch cost
